linked_process_id.description: Linked process identifier from eLabFTW (do not modify). Stored as text even if numeric.

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA chromatogram analysis pipeline

analysis_message.description: Human-readable message from the analysis script summarizing success or failure.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database (UTC ISO 8601).

summary.description: Key metrics from AKTA UV chromatogram analysis.

num_points.description: Number of time points in the processed chromatogram.

num_peaks_detected.description: Number of UV peaks detected in the chromatogram.

peaks.description: List of detected peaks with retention time and height.

uv_mAU.description: Peak height in mAU at 280 nm.

data_files.description: Output data file names from the analysis step.

processed_chromatogram_csv.description: Path to processed chromatogram CSV (time, UV, conductivity).

analysis_results_json.description: Path to JSON file with full analysis_results structure from the AKTA script.

chromatogram_png.description: Path to PNG chromatogram plot with detected peaks annotated.

chromatogram_pdf.description: Path to PDF chromatogram plot with detected peaks annotated.

files.description: Listing of all files found in results and analysis folders.

results_folder.description: All files present in ../results for this experiment.

analysis_folder.description: All files present in ../analysis for this experiment (if any).
